distinguishing_features: Q07/Q12: broad rectangular/barrel trunk with no waist, thick column legs, upright straight posture. Q08/Q10: inverted mass distribution - large rounded upper back/chest over a narrow waist, spindly arms and thighs, wavy S-shaped profile with forward knees and prominent calves, reads hunched/bent-kneed. Q12 is the least certain (could be read as an obese human).
